sample_rows.intro: Complete before use. Pass = satisfactory; Fail = defect/unsafe; N/A = not applicable (give the reason). Any Fail or uncertainty: STOP, prevent use and report to the supervisor.
sample_rows.footer: Recheck after moving or changed conditions. This is not the formal scaffold inspection report. All towers need inspection after assembly and at suitable intervals; construction towers with a possible fall of 2 m or more require inspection at least every 7 days. Arrange inspection after events affecting safety. If failed: competent person must rectify and authorise release; complete a new pre-use check.

sample_rows.footer: Complete daily before use; repeat after changes affecting safety. Perform function tests only as instructed by the manufacturer in a safe area. Do not bypass safety devices. This is not a LOLER examination (normally 6-monthly for lifting people, or per examination scheme). Hired MEWPs: weekly supervisor sign-off required while on hire. If failed: competent person must rectify and authorise release; complete a new pre-use check.
